cards.back: An ionic bond is formed when electrons are transferred from one atom to another, creating charged ions.
A covalent bond is formed when atoms share electrons to achieve stable electron configurations.
A measure of the acidity or alkalinity of a solution, ranging from 0 to 14.
The smallest unit of a compound that retains the chemical properties of that compound.
A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed.
The smallest unit of an element that retains the properties of that element.
A pure substance made up of only one type of atom.
A substance formed when two or more elements are chemically combined.
A combination of two or more substances that are not chemically combined.
A table of chemical elements arranged by atomic number and properties.
The loss of electrons by a molecule, atom, or ion.
The gain of electrons by a molecule, atom, or ion.
A chemical reaction involving the transfer of electrons between species.
A state where the forward and reverse reactions occur at equal rates.
When a system at equilibrium is disturbed, it will adjust to minimize the disturbance.
